pr_body: ### What problem does this PR solve? Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/34098 Problem Summary: This PR try to remove the temporary kv file download in TiKV and fix the issue that pd scan fewer region which caused data lost. ### What is changed and how it works? 1. Implement clearFiles rpc. 2. make endKey from exclusive to inclusive by `TruncateTS(end)` then `PrefixNext(end)`. 3. Split delete files and put files, make sure delete files apply after put files. ### Check List Tests - [x] Unit Test - [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below) ### Release note Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note. ```release-note None ```

issue_context.title: Remove temporary files after restore succeed.
issue_context.body: add a clear_files interface in kvproto: https://github.com/pingcap/kvproto/pull/901
comments:
This interface will remove directory of import file (including lightning and br full restore files).
I think we can simply remove `v1` prefix directory rather than the whole import path. @YuJuncen  WDYT?

review_comments: Maybe use `defer` here so if we failed to restore (or the user manually cancels restore) we can clean the temp files as normal?

if we want resume from some internal break. keep files can save some download time.
I think we better provider a manual cleanup files command.
